views.note: Two north windows, abstract bed art, silver mirror, a broad mirrored dresser, plant, armchair, laundry basket and flat rug fill the edges. The crib moves to the southeast; the twins stay by the northeast window. The original south door retains 96px access; the rug leaves the middle walkable.
Folded-linen shelf, low towel tray and flat runner furnish the north, west and south edges. Unique stitched fern picture. The existing east doorway remains reachable with a 96px square.
Clothes fill the north, a side-painted shoe shelf fills the east, and low boxes and hamper fill the south. Unique hat-and-scarf still life. The west opening and central 96px approach stay clear.
The tub shampoo row and tank plant are painted with their fixtures. Existing bathroom has one door.

A shallow east-facing-west coat console, a flat long runner and a unique small geometric north-wall picture fill the remaining wall stretches. Coats are painted edge-on. The 144px hall still connects all six openings with 96px clearance.
Painted carpeted stair flight and landings. Stair treads are walkable ground art; the east landing opens onto the hall.
Water heater, north supply shelves and low south storage furnish the edges. Unique technical sun-and-pipes print. The flat runner and east-side 96px access remain clear.
Hoop, net and medals hang on north bifold doors. One existing door opens on the east side.

Full 128px north wall with painted open oak doorway, not a carpet strip. Generic 60 YEARS IN SPACE poster and game-pad neon replace trademarks. Desk and chair tuck against the wall; beanbag, amp, rug and loose clothes fill the left edges. Both exits connect around a 224px open square.
